agent_assumptions: Interior door heights 2.1m assumed; window z absolute 3.8-5.6 (sill 800 + F2 floor z 3.0, height 1800 per all four elevations)
2F corridor walls modeled 120mm at drawn midplanes (y5.0/3.0), overriding conflicting 340/400 chain values
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: 2F corridor wall thickness: drawing 120mm vs both dimension chains 340-400mm; drawing followed, corridor clear 1880 vs chain 1200
No staircase on either plan; vertical circulation unrepresented
North window W2_N2 drawn ~140mm east of top-chain position; drawn kept
South partitions drawn at 3.80/11.31m vs chain 3.75/11.25m; drawn kept
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

plan_compilation.basis: 2f_view.png original pixels. Anchors at outer faces of 240 exterior walls: x px428=0m, px1812=15m; y px1071=0m, px331=8m. Representative planes: 2F corridor walls drawn as thin double lines y603-614 and y788-799 (~120mm) modeled at midplanes y608/y793 (world y=5.0/3.0, corridor clear ~1.88m). CONFLICT: 2F left chain (3000/400/1200/400/3000) and right chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940) both state corridor walls 340-400 thick and clear 1200; drawn geometry shows 120 walls with 1880 clear. Drawing followed; the corridor centerline y=4.0m agrees with both (corridor east/west windows 3.4-4.6). Interior partitions: meeting-room divider x1114-1126 (chain 120 thick, centerline 7.5m), south office partitions drawn x779/x1472 (chain positions 3750/11250 midpoints of 360+360 gaps); modeled at drawn midplanes.

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
